title: Material
description: Represents a cleaning material or supply in the global materials catalog.

name.description: The name of the material (e.g., 'منظف الأرضيات', 'Floor Cleaner').

description.description: A detailed description of the material and its uses.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the material was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the material was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
